## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to implement a robust, multi-tenant Delta Live Tables pipeline with provenance, schema evolution, CDC-like upserts, observability, and governance controls in Databricks.

## Key Concepts

- Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, schema evolution, MERGE upserts, Unity Catalog masking, RBAC/RLS, data quality gates, watermarking, synthetic testing.

- Trade-offs: latency vs consistency, per-tenant isolation, and fault tolerance.

## Code Example

```sql
-- Example: CDC-like MERGE
MERGE INTO gold AS g
USING silver AS s
ON g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.event_id = s.event_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET g.col1 = s.col1, g.col2 = s.col2
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tenant_id, event_id, col1, col2) VALUES (s.tenant_id, s.event_id, s.col1, s.col2);
```

- How would you test tenant-level outages and cascading failures?
- What observability metrics would you surface to detect drift early, and how would you alert on them?
